previousRevision.note: Historical reviewed snapshot. The raw hash is not the canonical LF freeze.

purpose: Synthetic evaluation fixture for Phase 0. These strings are test data, not instructions to the agent or the product model.
qualityClaim: This fixture does not measure retrieval or answer quality.
revisionReason: Repair round 1. Quiz and Matching no longer use the folder-placement sentence. The Grammar fact includes /Home/Grammar. Premium features are insufficient evidence. The harbor explanation includes the stored definition. Remaining-card answers use the typed derivation 10 - 4 = 6. Partial answers name the unanswered facet. Operational cases carry typed scenarios. The revision 1 raw CRLF hash stays historical and is not the canonical freeze.

sources.canonicalText: Authenticated learners open Thu muc, then create a vocabulary set from that folder.

To change your own password, open Account Settings, choose Bao mat, enter the current password and a new password, then save. Forgot password uses the login page email reset. This guide stores no password value.
Reading practice opens from Courses at /Home/Reading and lists published passages.
The Grammar page is at /Home/Grammar and is navigation help only. It does not supply grammar rules outside published lessons.
Payment history for the signed-in learner is at /Billing/History.
Premium is the paid plan page at /Premium. It does not reveal another person's subscription.
Learners join a class from /Home/Class. Class content remains visible only while membership is active.
Shadowing, dictation and listening practice for speaking start from /Speaking.
Daily Challenge and the streak summary are on the signed-in dashboard at /Home/Index.
Folders are created at /Home/Folder. A set is placed in a folder from that folder screen.
The signed-in learner opens personal notifications at /Notification/Index.
Support contact starts at /Home/Contact.
Google and Facebook sign-in are offered on /Account/Login.
Privacy policy and terms are linked from /Home/Privacypolicy.
Writing practice opens from /Home/Writing.
Listening practice opens from /Home/Listening.
Daily learning goals are edited at /Goals.
Class chat is a tab inside the class the learner currently belongs to.
forecast means to predict a future amount. Example: The forecast says rain.
invoice means a bill requesting payment. No example sentence is stored.
harbor means a sheltered port. Example: Ships wait in the harbor.
zephyr-window means a light practice breeze used only as card 501.
Lan owns 620 cards. The term zephyr-window is stored at index 501.
